text:
alex: CI microbench failed on PR #18822, kernel_selector_bench delta +12% (threshold +5%). Can't ignore this for the rollout.
maria: ugh. which runner? any repro logs?
alex: p100-ci-3. attach from ci log:
```
[ RUN      ] KernelSelectorBench/Latency
baseline: 12.3ms
current: 13.8ms  (+12.2%)
Threshold: +5.0%
Summary: kernel_cost_table load: updated scale=1.4 -> 0.9 in commit 0a7d3f
```
jin: that commit sounds suspicious — it touched kernel-cost scaling and concat quant paths.
tess: I also see KV cache hitrate dropped in the perf profile for the failing run — from ~78% to ~43%.
alex: flame link: https://perf.internal/runs/596789/fg
ci-bot: microbench-run: artifacts uploaded -> s3://ci-artifacts/596789/bench.tar.gz
maria: if KV hit drops, requests push to fallback kernel more often -> more mem copies -> latency.
sanjay: starting a quick bisect across the last 10 commits to isolate. will run microbench with kv-hitrate counters.
tess: repro command (local):
```
./bazel run //bench:kernel_selector_bench -- --seq=1024 --batch=1 --seed=42
```
alex: local repro reproduces the +10-13% delta when kernel_cost.json from commit 0a7d3f is applied.
sanjay: bisect result: commit 0a7d3f is the first bad commit. it changed kernel_cost.json scaling and added an affinity tweak for quant-concat.
maria: plan: open a targeted revert of the kernel_cost scale change only, keep the affinity tweak out until we understand perf impact.
alex: if we revert scale, microbench drops back under threshold but we should run canary on dedicated infra.
tess: I'll prepare a canary job config for the dedicated pool and run overnight.
deploy-bot: created revert PR #18845 (revert 0a7d3f kernel cost scale). linking CI.
ci-bot: CI queued for PR #18845 on p100-ci-3 and dedicated-canary. expected ~25m.
alex: thanks — good triage. leave notes for release manager about rollback path if canary shows persistent tail.
maria: adding perf regression tag and assigning follow-up to @jin to audit kernel cost heuristics.
jin: on it. I'll add a small unit test to catch large kv-hit regressions in CI microbench.
